classification.difficultyReason: Construct a two-circle diagram from listed sets, identifying the overlap and outside elements.

content.prompt:
$\xi=\{\text{integers from 1 to 9 inclusive}\}$

$A=\{1,2,3,4\}$, $B=\{3,4,5,6\}$

Draw a Venn diagram to represent this information.

answer.worked: Place the common elements $3,4$ in the overlap. Place $1,2$ in $A$ only and $5,6$ in $B$ only. Place the remaining elements of $\xi$, namely $7,8,9$, outside both circles but inside the rectangle.
